image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a sliced meatloaf in a dark baking pan. The loaf is cut in half, revealing the interior texture and two large, circular slices of pickled jalapeño peppers embedded in the center of each half. The exterior is coated in a glossy, reddish-brown glaze, likely ketchup or tomato-based, with some darker caramelized areas. The interior meat appears dense and ground, with visible flecks of vegetables (onions/peppers) mixed in.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'jalapeño' insertion. While delicious, AI often struggles with embedding objects inside other objects, leading to 'floating' peppers or melted boundaries. Verify if the peppers look physically baked-in or just pasted on top. Also, scrutinize the bottom contact points with the pan for 'mushing' artifacts.
